label.explanation: enrichment-svc v1.21.0 rolled out with a new response serializer (lines 224, 232) that renamed "status" to "state". From then on ingest-api cannot decode enrichment-svc's responses (lines 239, 243, 262, 264), which surfaces as ingest-gateway 502s (lines 238, 246, 261, 266, 271, 276, 286, 289, 291, 298, 305, 312). enrichment-svc itself logs no errors — the break is the contract, introduced by the release. Roll back enrichment-svc. Red herrings: line 216 (a one-off slow reporting query on audit_log, not on the failing request path); line 68 (a certificate expiry reminder weeks out); line 227 (a config reload that changed nothing); line 219 (a client sending one invalid request, rejected correctly with a 400).
